scope: Pour water from a bottle held by the Quanta X1 robot into a graduated cylinder, then return the bottle upright.

gaps: Calibrated discharge and outlet velocity as functions of fill level, bottle geometry, tilt, motion, and air entering the bottle.
Physical interactions with the cylinder rim and walls, including splashing and dripping. The current model uses a geometric opening test.
Sloshing, shifting center of mass, and changing inertia. The rigid water proxy stays in the model and the load correction only offsets static weight.
water_stream_and_dynamics.validation: Compare flow, shutoff timing, collected volume, and spill against measured physical pours across fill levels and tilt profiles.

gaps: Actual finger and bottle geometry, contact, friction, grip force, and compliance.
Bottle movement relative to the gripper, including shifting, rotation, slip, and dropping during lift and tilt.
The effect of an uncertain or changing grasp on the bottle-mouth pose and motion commands.
Acquiring the grasp and opening the bottle if these are included in the full task.
grasp_and_container.validation: Validate upright hold, lift, and slow tilt with the imported fingers and no cylinder support. Compare slip and retention with physical trials.

gaps: Real actuator gains, force and speed limits, tracking error, delay, backlash, and gravity compensation behavior.
Sensor-based estimates of bottle and cylinder pose and delivered volume, including calibration error, noise, occlusion, and delay.
Complete collision and clearance behavior, including robot self-collision and motion between sampled planned poses.
Measured robot, gripper, bottle, cylinder, and workspace geometry and their actual positions.
Base positioning error, stability, and motion under load where relevant; the isolated pour currently assumes a parked base.
robot_and_environment.validation: Measure geometry, actuator tracking, and sensor performance on the real setup; check collisions and clearances throughout motion.

integration_gap: Connect the scripted and learned controllers to the shared MuJoCo motion layer, then evaluate them with the parcel water model and validated free grasp.
